title: Senior Backend Distributed Systems Engineer
description_raw: We are seeking a Senior Backend Distributed Systems Engineer to scale our core event-driven infrastructure. You will architect and maintain high-throughput microservices, design reliable message queuing systems using Apache Kafka, and optimize low-latency data pipelines. Ideal candidates have deep expertise in Python or Go, concurrent computing, Kubernetes container orchestration, and observability in mission-critical environments.

requirements.requirement_text: 5+ years architecting high-throughput distributed systems in Python or Go
Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or event-driven streaming
Production experience managing workloads on Kubernetes and Docker
Strong background in gRPC, REST API design, and protocol buffers
Familiarity with distributed cache topologies like Redis or Memcached
